_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Control Surface Mass Properties, Freeplay, and Rigidity Tests Report
summary: Specifies the format and content for the Control Surface Mass Properties, Freeplay, and Rigidity Tests Report, which provides data for evaluating mass and stiffness of control surfaces and actuation systems to validate or update aeroelastic and aeroservoelastic flutter analyses.
use_relationship:
The Control Surface Mass Properties, Freeplay, and Rigidity Tests Report is used to provide the data for the detailed evaluation of the mass and stiffness of the air vehicle's control surfaces and actuation system.  It is used to establish free-play limits and update the aeroelastic and aeroservoelastic flutter analyses.  The principal use of the report is to validate or update analytical models.

This Data Item Description (DID) is applicable to any contract for which an air vehicle is being developed, or a control surface, its associated backup structure, or linkages are being modified.

This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in section 5 of MIL-STD-1530, Aircraft Structural Integrity Program (ASIP).

This DID supersedes DI-MISC-81387, Airframe Rigidity Test Report.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Control Surface Mass Properties, Freeplay, and Rigidity Tests Report shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The Control Surface Mass Properties, Freeplay, and Rigidity Tests Report shall describe the contractor's analyses and ground test activities associated with characterizing the mass, inertia, rigidity, freeplay, and wear rates of the flight control augmentation system and its components.  The report shall contain the results and findings of the tests and measurements used to validate and update the aeroelastic and aeroservoelastic models and analyses, to include the following:

children.title: The report shall contain the planning, procedures, results, and findings for the following tests and measurements
Control surface, tab, and actuator rigidity tests
Control surface and tab freeplay tests
Control surface, tab, and actuator component wear tests
Mass property measurements of control surfaces and tabs
Flutter damper qualification and wear tests
Presentation of test plans and results, which shall include
Descriptions and photographs of the air vehicle, fixturing, rigging, ground equipment, instrumentation, and component(s) under test
Descriptions of test procedures, test conditions, test methods, test equipment, load application method and locations, loading rates, data acquisition system, and methods of data reduction analysis
Copy of the test matrix as planned to be executed
Description of the methods used for selecting test instrumentation types, test instrumentation measurement capabilities, and test measurement locations
Description of the methods used for mounting instrumentation
Specifications for all test instrumentation
Descriptions of the aircraft flight control and actuation system including layout, dimensions, and method of operation
Description of the methods used to control actuators and actuation systems
Defined measurement units including axis labels of plots and figures
Plots of the transfer functions versus frequency for vibration sensors
Measurements of the freeplay and loop stiffness of each control surface and tab of the flight control augmentation system

Freeplay contribution of the individual components of the flight control augmentation system linkage and total freeplay for each control surface and tab along with a description of the methodology used to interpret the test data
Wear rates of individual components of the flight control augmentation system linkage for each control surface and tab along with a description of the methodology used to interpret the test data
Actuator impedance results as a function of frequency
Flutter damper impedance and functional service life limits
Mass and inertial properties of the control surfaces and tabs
Copy of the test log as executed
Control surface and tab balance weight locations, tolerances, and configurations, including any necessary adjustments to the balance weight based on test and measurement results
